messages.subject: FW: Referral
messages.body:
Good morning. See below sample email I sent to some banker friends. The list of people I sent it to are in the attached Word file. I would send them an email (prob Monday - they may not be doing much today...) along the lines of "...I understand Chris Miller forwarded my resume...I would greatly appreciate connecting with your UT recruiting team in the Houston office..." You can dress it up but I think if you can just get them to copy in some UT analyst in their office, that would be great (many of these guys aren't inclined to go to much effort on it, so I'm trying to think of minimal effort needed from them to get you what you want!

I'm also rounding up a couple of analysts on my side for an intro

Good luck!

[quoted, Chris Miller's own outbound to b.hutchinson@baml.com, Jan 19 10:23]
Hope you're doing well and had a good break. Forwarding a UT Sophomore resume for Summer Analyst position. Fantastic background and major self-starter (I've known him for 10 years and he's done some really amazing things). I'm trying to connect him with the Analyst community in Houston (he's from California). Could you please forward to one of your UT analysts? Thanks and I hope you have a bountiful year!

Christopher B. Miller, Managing Director, Vice Chairman | Citi Energy Investment Banking
